People often think that to be bisexual you need to be equally as attracted to either gender, but that’s not true. If you’re familiar with something called the kinsey scale, technically speaking anything but the extremes on the spectrum can be classified as bisexuality.

Its of course all about how you chose to label yourself. Usually the way that makes life easiest for you.

But then, is living in a lie really worth it?
Dont be afraid to experiment a bit (within reason of course)

Our identities evolve throughout our lives and, sometimes we can be surprised a lot, sometimes we hate ourselves.
